day_shape: 106 items: US CENTCOM says its blockade of Iran has redirected 103 commercial vessels, IDF confirms killing Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, UNSC emergency session on Houthi advance toward Bab al-Mandab, Mahsa Amini fourth anniversary strikes in western Iran, heavy IRGC 'Jaan Fada' 200-nights messaging cycle.

threads.label: US Iran blockade and Hormuz shipping
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 103 commercial vessels enforcing the blockade against Iran in the Arabian Sea, with Strait of Hormuz crossings in single digits. Secretary Rubio spoke with Omani FM al-Busaidi condemning Iranian attacks on shipping, while Iran International reported Tehran blaming Washington for postponement of Oman-hosted Hormuz talks.

threads.label: Houthi advance and Mecca drone claim
threads.summary: The UN Security Council held an emergency session on Houthi advances toward Bab al-Mandab, with UK Ambassador Kate Foster placing full responsibility on the Houthis. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a drone south of Mecca; Houthis denied targeting Mecca but claimed downing a Saudi F-15 over Marib, echoed by Defa Press.

threads.label: IDF kills Hamas Rafah Brigade commander
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed killing Nael Abu Obeid, commander of Hamas's Rafah Brigade and head of its military wing operations array, in an airstrike in southern Gaza. Netanyahu and Katz confirmed the target; the IDF separately announced killing PIJ rocket-cell commander Mohsen Farid Said Abu Hadaf, an October 7 infiltrator.

threads.label: IRGC '200 nights' Jaan Fada messaging
threads.summary: IRGC commanders including Vahidi, Hatami, Shekarchchi and Jaan Fada spokesman Zarei issued a coordinated cycle of statements marking 200 nights of public 'martyrdom-seeker' mobilisation, and announced training of 1,000 specialised Jaan Fada battalions. Tehran traffic police announced arrangements for a planned 313,000-strong exercise on 27 Shahrivar.

threads.label: Mahsa Amini fourth anniversary
threads.summary: Iran International reported security forces deploying across western Iranian cities as shopkeepers struck to mark four years since Mahsa Amini's death, and profiled the Woman, Life, Freedom generation. An Iranian appeals court upheld the death sentence of January protest detainee Ali Rahimi Rigi, while twin Taraneh Rahimi is reportedly being denied food on death row.

threads.label: US political friction over Iran war
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the US House passed a resolution directing Trump to withdraw US forces from Iran except those needed for imminent defence, and Rep. Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. VP JD Vance was reported saying the war with Iran would enter a 'much different phase' after the US midterms.

threads.label: Iran nuclear file and explosions
threads.summary: Israel's Atomic Energy Commission Director-General Moshe Edri told the IAEA general conference Iran holds over nine tons of nuclear material outside safeguards, while IAEA signed a 2026–2031 Country Programme Framework with Syria. Jerusalem Post cited IRNA reporting several explosions on Qeshm Island; IRIB flagged planned ordnance-destruction blasts on Kharg and in south Isfahan.
